selected_evidence.requirement: inventorysvc is a system account with the requested home and no interactive login
selected_evidence.summary: Shows UID 997 below UID_MIN 1000, /var/lib/inventory as the home, inventorysvc ownership, /sbin/nologin, locked password status, and a denied login attempt before and after restart.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID bdbfa15c-cfc4-4b36-8edd-d0a49076e9c5, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 9d9d8244-2dda-4c4e-85f1-ece34c1458bf, and recovered account data with SSH active and system state running.
